collection: KVL national-team candidate and selection evidence

policy.scope: Source-verified official candidate/preliminary/longlist, weekly, final or match-specific rosters. Not the same as a national-team tournament roster snapshot.
policy.no_inference: Absence from a later roster is not a confirmed cut, disqualification, injury, non-participation or country withdrawal.
policy.identity: Only source-verified permanent player IDs may be compared. Names, jersey numbers and unreviewed provider IDs are not identity keys.
policy.privacy: Public athlete fields only. Preserve the original source URL, publication date, and review state.
